issue.title: Bug: crm/test_crm.py::test_crm_route is flaky on platforms that use total_routes = 1

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the bug

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/22132 added polling with counter tolerance 2, but when total_routes is 1 the tolerance let the wait pass before the CRM counter actually moved, which makes wait_until check for check_route_added/check_route_deleted useless and the test flaky.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run crm/test_crm.py::test_crm_route on broadcom XGS platforms

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

wait_until check for check_route_added/check_route_deleted should address total_routes = 1

resolution.title: Fix CRM route polling for single-route case
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
#22132 added polling with counter tolerance, but when total_routes is 1 the tolerance let the wait pass before the CRM counter actually moved. Require at least one route worth of movement on add, and tighten delete polling back to baseline for the single-route case.
Fixes #25661
